description.content:
Date filtering expects RFC3339 / ISO-8601 timestamps (UTC recommended).
Preferred examples:
  - 2022-12-01T00:00:00Z
  - 2022-12-01T00:00:00+00:00
Legacy format currently accepted for backward compatibility (discouraged):
  - 2022-12-01T00:00:00+0000
